name: miraiwerk
description: MIRAIWERK AI — the intelligence engine for projects that move forward.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && ../.venv/bin/python manage.py collectstatic --noinput --verbosity 0 >/dev/null && ../.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn miraiwerk.asgi:application --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run build -w @miraiwerk/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:deps && npm run typecheck -w @miraiwerk/frontend
